quotes.name: Devouring Light
quotes.flavor: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

quotes.name: Fleeting Image
quotes.flavor: Horas swore off drinking, but after meeting the creature a second time he decided he'd better start again.

quotes.name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
quotes.flavor: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

quotes.name: Spawning Breath
quotes.flavor: Death by death, Kozilek's lineage spread.

quotes.name: Lure
quotes.flavor: It makes the insignificant conspicuous, the repulsive alluring, and the deadly irresistible.

quotes.name: Spider-Man 2099, Miguel O'Hara
quotes.flavor: "Lyla, did it work? Are we in the Heroic Age?"

quotes.name: Fires of Yavimaya
quotes.flavor: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

quotes.name: Deadly Recluse
quotes.flavor: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

quotes.name: Battlefront Krushok
quotes.flavor: Krushoks clear debris from fertile fields, fallow fields, and battlefields.

quotes.name: Hullcarver
quotes.flavor:
"Sunstar thinking is too linear. While they fight head-on, we hit them everywhere else."
—Alpharael, Stonechosen

quotes.name: Voracious Greatshark
quotes.flavor: There is no boat big enough.

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor:
"Born under the moon, the second child will stumble on temptation and seek power in the dark places of the heart."
—Codex of the Constellari

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

quotes.name: Sporeweb Weaver
quotes.flavor: It spins its web throughout the undercity, strange growths sprouting in its wake.

quotes.name: Thieving Magpie
quotes.flavor: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Enchantress
quotes.flavor: From each seed, a world. From each world, a thousand seeds.

quotes.name: Beetle-Headed Merchants
quotes.flavor: To these desert-dwelling traders, there is profit to be found under every dune of sand and in every living thing.

quotes.name: Iron Man, Master of Machines
quotes.flavor: "The future is what we make it."

quotes.name: Supreme Phantom
quotes.flavor: A king's knowledge does not vanish when the heart stops beating.

quotes.name: Legions to Ashes
quotes.flavor:
"For the love of the seven brass gods, it's a city of academics! How are they doing this?"
—Sharaman, Urzan lieutenant

quotes.name: Rukh Egg
quotes.flavor: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

quotes.name: Wing It
quotes.flavor: After a moment's confusion, the otter splashed through clouds and gamboled in the wind, delighting in its newfound freedom.

quotes.name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
quotes.flavor: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor:
"Let the past be the past. Do not call up that which you cannot put down. Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

quotes.name: Tranquil Expanse
quotes.flavor: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

quotes.name: An-Havva Constable
quotes.flavor:
"Joskun and the other constables serve with passion, if not with grace."
—Devin, faerie noble

quotes.name: Read the Bones
quotes.flavor: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Regicide
quotes.flavor: "You're done!"

quotes.name: Aphotic Wisps
quotes.flavor: Merrows skulk the silty bogs around the Wanderbrine, their very thoughts stained with evil.

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Crossway Vampire
quotes.flavor: "Do not flatter Fate. It did not guide you into my clutches tonight. That was all my doing."

quotes.name: Your Puny Minds Cannot Fathom
quotes.flavor: "I have seen far beyond this imperfect world, into a tomorrow that doesn't include you."

quotes.name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
quotes.flavor: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Foundry Street Denizen
quotes.flavor: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

quotes.name: Echo Storm
quotes.flavor: An organized and methodical reproduction.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Goblin Electromancer
quotes.flavor:
"Result 752: Rapid mass redistribution.
"Result 753: Calamitous reverse synthesis.
"Result 754: Acute disarrayment."
—Izzet research notes

quotes.name: Owlin Spiralmancer
quotes.flavor: "I come up here to practice. You can see the entire Garden twisting reality. It's inspiring."

quotes.name: Exorcise
quotes.flavor:
"Strictly speaking, you can't kill what's already dead, but trapping and disintegrating it is pretty close."
—Garden, survivor technologist

quotes.name: Magus of the Vineyard
quotes.flavor: Battered and beaten by years of salt and claw, he never ceased to walk, and to seed. Only now, in this time of rebirth, do his seeds take root.

quotes.name: Ancestral Mask
quotes.flavor: "I pass to you all we have ever been. Go forth and become all we never could."

quotes.name: Maalfeld Twins
quotes.flavor:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
quotes.flavor:
Many live lives of quiet desperation. His
is quite loud.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: There are as many ways to travel the galaxy as there are stars in the sky.

quotes.name: Oona's Prowler
quotes.flavor: Deep in Glen Elendra blossoms Oona, queen of the faeries, nourished by secrets and pollinated by stolen dreams.

quotes.name: Mind Sludge
quotes.flavor: When you get into the swamp, the swamp gets into you.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Fleetfoot Dancer
quotes.flavor: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge. When word spread of how many were slain at the first event, it became a citywide obsession.

quotes.name: Control Magic
quotes.flavor:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Deathmark
quotes.flavor: Even the noblest of intentions and strongest of wills inevitably crumble into dust.

quotes.name: Grim Backwoods
quotes.flavor:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Dragon's Claw
quotes.flavor:
"If there is a fire that never ceases to burn, it surely lies in the maw of a dragon."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Turbulent Steppe
quotes.flavor:
"Respect for the past is respect for oneself. It's an admission that we too shall pass into history."
—Velomachus Lorehold

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor: Few truly live in the moment.

quotes.name: Armor of Faith
quotes.flavor:
"Keep your chainmail, warrior. I have my own form of protection."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Dockworker Drone
quotes.flavor: Eternity columns are the trade hubs of every solar system.

quotes.name: Gust-Skimmer
quotes.flavor: Phyrexian smog clouds choked the skies, threatening creatures who couldn't comprehend the menace below.

quotes.name: Syphon Mind
quotes.flavor: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

quotes.name: Voldaren Epicure
quotes.flavor: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

quotes.name: Shivan Gorge
quotes.flavor: Both forge and pyre.

quotes.name: Information Booth
quotes.flavor:
"When I arrived, I was looking for the costume shop. But when I left, I'd learned what I was really looking for: myself. Five stars."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

quotes.name: Talisman of Indulgence
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, Doctor. Fooling you once was a joy, but fooling you twice the same way? It's a privilege."
—Madame Kovarian

quotes.name: Condescend
quotes.flavor: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

quotes.name: Counsel of the Soratami
quotes.flavor: "Wisdom is not the counting of all the drops in a waterfall. Wisdom is learning why the water seeks the earth."

quotes.name: Colossal Dreadmaw
quotes.flavor: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

quotes.name: Generous Stray
quotes.flavor: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.

quotes.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
quotes.flavor: Now insects occupy a special place in his lungs, intestines, liver, kidneys, eyeballs...

quotes.name: Balduvian Rage
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Entomb
quotes.flavor:
"I'll return once you've ripened."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Invert Polarity
quotes.flavor:
"Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with... Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
quotes.flavor: Great hero or grand betrayer? The truth of Ezuri's legacy is clouded by the fog of legend.

quotes.name: Harbin, Vanguard Aviator
quotes.flavor: "Yotia is my birthright, father. Let me fight for it."

quotes.name: Graven Lore
quotes.flavor: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

quotes.name: Thieving Magpie
quotes.flavor: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Naga Vitalist
quotes.flavor: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."

quotes.name: Esquire of the King
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Where now the horse and the rider?
Where is the horn that was blowing?
Where is the helm and the hauberk,
and the bright hair flowing?"
—Lament for the Rohirrim

quotes.name: Spirit of the Season
quotes.flavor: Summoned for all the wrong seasons.

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
quotes.flavor: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Fangblade Brigand // Fangblade Eviscerator
quotes.flavor: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

quotes.name: Lambholt Harrier
quotes.flavor:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch

quotes.name: Bladed Ambassador
quotes.flavor: "Let those thanebound dissenters prattle about their dead god. I serve the Mother of Machines, and in her name I carve out their heresy."

quotes.name: Torpor Orb
quotes.flavor:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

quotes.name: Relentless Rats
quotes.flavor: Each of them is a bad influence on the rest.

quotes.name: Monoskelion
quotes.flavor: An unfinished body with unfinished business.

quotes.name: Manaplasm
quotes.flavor: Urak froze when he heard it. That was his first mistake. He turned and cast a dramatic ward spell. That was his last.

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.

quotes.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
quotes.flavor: "The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

quotes.name: Defective Detective
quotes.flavor: Nothing gets by her . . . except the evidence, the motive, and the culprit.

quotes.name: Glass Casket
quotes.flavor: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

quotes.name: Emerge from the Cocoon
quotes.flavor: Within the silken shroud, all doubts are cleansed, and all desires are united with Valgavoth.

quotes.name: Bloodbond Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Perilous Forays
quotes.flavor:
"*This* is the place? This map has got to be wrong . . . ."
—Svania Trul, wayfinder novice, last words

quotes.name: Vryn Wingmare
quotes.flavor: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

quotes.name: Flood of Tears
quotes.flavor:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling

quotes.name: Goblin Grenade
quotes.flavor:
"According to accepted theory, the grenade held some kind of flammable mixture and was carried to its target by a hapless goblin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Armistice
quotes.flavor:
We all must profit for peace to last.
—Mercadian saying

quotes.name: Twisted Spider-Clone
quotes.flavor:
"Glurp!"
—Shift, clone of Spider-Man

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Maddening Wind
quotes.flavor:
"It is Freyalise, walking on the world."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

quotes.name: Rotfeaster Maggot
quotes.flavor: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

quotes.name: Call the Spirit Dragons
quotes.flavor: The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.

quotes.name: Death Pits of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"Neither could I forget what I had read of these pits—that the *sudden* extinction of life formed no part of their most horrible plan."
—Edgar Allan Poe,
"The Pit and the Pendulum"

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor:
"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember."
—Clara Oswald

quotes.name: Foundry Assembler
quotes.flavor:
"They never tire, they never complain, and they never ask questions. Build more."
—Ivash, Consulate inventor

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Gravedigger
quotes.flavor: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Only one loyal subject did not fear the wrath of the Marchioness—her beloved "Fluffin."

quotes.name: Skyway Sniper
quotes.flavor: "No sight is more beautiful than a clear sky."

quotes.name: Steelshaper's Gift
quotes.flavor: "People say, 'Oh, it's dangerous to keep weapons in the home or the workplace.' Well, I say it's better to be hurt by someone you know accidentally than by a stranger on purpose."

quotes.name: Frontier Bivouac
quotes.flavor:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

quotes.name: Glory Seeker
quotes.flavor: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

quotes.name: Dauthi Jackal
quotes.flavor:
"All dauthi are jackals, regardless of breed."
—Lyna, soltari emissary

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Mystic Gate
quotes.flavor: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor: What wizards fear most is losing their minds.

quotes.name: Crovax, Ascendant Hero
quotes.flavor: Crovax was destined for an angel's curse, but one warped timeline saw the noble redeemed.

quotes.name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
quotes.flavor: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

quotes.name: Placid Rottentail
quotes.flavor: It had always loved munching on daisies and crystalweed, but lately its favorite snacks were the strange, round roots popping up everywhere.

quotes.name: Mystic Redaction
quotes.flavor: "I'm sorry, but this information is classified."

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor: "That's the third time! And it wasn't funny the first two times either, Jim."

quotes.name: Orzhov Enforcer
quotes.flavor: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

quotes.name: Moon Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"I am that merry wanderer of the night."
—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

quotes.name: Rushwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

quotes.name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
quotes.flavor: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

quotes.name: Arwen, Weaver of Hope
quotes.flavor: From afar, Arwen watched over Aragorn, and in hope, she made for him a great and kingly standard.

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Constricting Tendrils
quotes.flavor: Priests of Bant protect their temples with traps more elaborate than any mosaic floor.

quotes.name: Vampire Neonate
quotes.flavor: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

quotes.name: Quicksmith Rebel
quotes.flavor: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

quotes.name: Aether Tunnel
quotes.flavor: If you can't find a doorway, make one.

quotes.name: Myr Retriever
quotes.flavor: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

quotes.name: Bureau Headmaster
quotes.flavor:
"Don't let our creed fade."
—Tahira, the First Oath-Taker

quotes.name: Icequake
quotes.flavor:
"When the earth shakes, and their animals are swallowed up by the ground, perhaps they will think twice before attacking again."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Barrenton Cragtreads
quotes.flavor: "Boggarts are easy to get around. Just toss some mutton in another direction. Giants are a little harder. You have to be quick to avoid their steps. Cinders are the difficult ones, but even they have fears to be exploited."

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Stonefare Crocodile
quotes.flavor: The Izzet's plans to exploit the undercity ran into a few stubborn obstacles.

quotes.name: Bramble Sovereign
quotes.flavor: "Within this grove, you belong to me."

quotes.name: Draconian Cylix
quotes.flavor:
"There is no gain without sacrifice."
—Icatian proverb

quotes.name: Dark Privilege
quotes.flavor:
"As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."
—Purraj of Urborg

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Grixis Panorama
quotes.flavor: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

quotes.name: Scourge of Nel Toth
quotes.flavor:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

quotes.name: Brindle Boar
quotes.flavor:
"Tell the cooks to prepare the fires. Tonight we feast!"
—Tolar Wolfbrother, Krosan tracker

quotes.name: Time Warp
quotes.flavor: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

quotes.name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
quotes.flavor: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

quotes.name: Ember Weaver
quotes.flavor:
"Each night, the sun unravels and blows away. Each day, the spiders set a new one in the sky."
—Sunseeder myth

quotes.name: Tovolar's Huntmaster // Tovolar's Packleader
quotes.flavor: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

quotes.name: Presumed Dead
quotes.flavor: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: The storm of mana thundered and crackled with unlimited possibility. It would be beautiful, if it weren't so deadly.

quotes.name: Nest Invader
quotes.flavor: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

quotes.name: Heat Ray
quotes.flavor:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: He is the roaring hurricane, the earthquake's sundering fury, the embodiment of wild, untamable power.

quotes.name: Frenzied Goblin
quotes.flavor: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

quotes.name: Xathrid Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

quotes.name: Blood Moon
quotes.flavor: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

quotes.name: Invoke the Firemind
quotes.flavor: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

quotes.name: Hero's Blade
quotes.flavor: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Broodlings
quotes.flavor: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

quotes.name: The Bear Force Pilot
quotes.flavor: WHO

quotes.name: Orzhov Cluestone
quotes.flavor: A symbol of power and wealth, the only commodities that matter to the Orzhov.

quotes.name: Scaled Wurm
quotes.flavor: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.

quotes.name: Somber Hoverguard
quotes.flavor: The vedalken interrogate all intruders—once the hoverguards are done with them.

quotes.name: Nantuko Mentor
quotes.flavor:
That which grows without roots cannot be uprooted.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Balefire Dragon
quotes.flavor: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

quotes.name: Elven Raft-Steerer
quotes.flavor:
"Float beyond the world of trees
Out into the whispering breeze."

quotes.name: Electroduplicate
quotes.flavor: The dragon roared and the storm thundered back.

quotes.name: Wee Dragonauts
quotes.flavor:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

quotes.name: Strength of the Harvest // Haven of the Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"For us, a temple is a part of nature, not something we impose upon it."
—Sythis, Harvest's Hand

quotes.name: Dualcaster Mage
quotes.flavor: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

quotes.name: Strionic Resonator
quotes.flavor: Nobody knew what the relic did, only that it was growing louder.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Unleash Fury
quotes.flavor: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Starting Column
quotes.flavor: Ten teams. Ten dreams. One winner.

quotes.name: Scorching Dragonfire
quotes.flavor: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

quotes.name: Wirewood Savage
quotes.flavor:
"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

quotes.name: South Wind Avatar
quotes.flavor: Snake-Eyes's gift takes others back to their worst memory. To the weak, it is a curse; to the wise, a second chance.

quotes.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
quotes.flavor: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Spearbreaker Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Few Nayans dare hunt the gargantuans. They're regarded not as animals but as forces of nature, like landslides or typhoons.

quotes.name: Vigilance
quotes.flavor:
"Put a spear in a peasant's hands, and you have an expendable troop. Put a purpose in his heart, and you win a warrior."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

quotes.name: Disallow
quotes.flavor:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

quotes.name: War Machine, Avenging Arsenal
quotes.flavor: There's always room for a little more firepower.

quotes.name: Arrows of Justice
quotes.flavor: Archers from the Horizon Military Academy hone their skills by targeting pickpockets blocks away.

quotes.name: False Cure
quotes.flavor:
"I do unto others as others have done unto me."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Bubble Matrix
quotes.flavor:
"This device was commisioned by a king who desired peace. Unfortunately, the royal artificer was also the king's jester."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Essence Capture
quotes.flavor: Might or Magic? Recent Clash Fuels Debate

quotes.name: Seismic Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!"
—Sergeant Ryda

quotes.name: Nightbird's Clutches
quotes.flavor: Shiny polished silver can ward off many creatures, but it attracts others.

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
quotes.flavor: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

quotes.name: Parallel Lives
quotes.flavor:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—*Curse of the Werefox*

quotes.name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: Boomerang managed to assemble a squad that really wasn't all that sinister and certainly wasn't all that six.

quotes.name: Ihsan's Shade
quotes.flavor: No mortal could atone for Ihsan's betrayal. Redemption required him to become something else.

quotes.name: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan
quotes.flavor: Swimming in coins proved harder than they'd hoped, but dancing was a jingling delight.

quotes.name: Melira, Sylvok Outcast
quotes.flavor: Once a pariah, now Mirrodin's greatest hope.

quotes.name: Gandalf, Friend of the Shire
quotes.flavor: "After a hundred years, Hobbits can still surprise you at a pinch."

quotes.name: Bond of Insight
quotes.flavor: "Together we can unlock secrets no one has even dreamed of. I might even let you remember some of them."

quotes.name: Dungeon Delver
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You're driven not by a lust for gold or baubles, but by the thrill of danger and the excitement of the unknown.

quotes.name: Skullslither Worm
quotes.flavor: As larvae, they burrow into a host's brain to feed upon it, growing until they're large enough to burst free and seek out larger prey.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

quotes.name: Tormod's Crypt
quotes.flavor: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

quotes.name: Lunarch Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

quotes.name: Ohran Frostfang
quotes.flavor: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

quotes.name: Burning Prophet
quotes.flavor: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

quotes.name: Fowl Play
quotes.flavor: "I feel like chicken tonight!"

quotes.name: Asgardian Inspiration
quotes.flavor: "Mayhaps you've fought a Thor, but you've never fought this Thor."

quotes.name: Thornweald Archer
quotes.flavor: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

quotes.name: Deflecting Palm
quotes.flavor:
「歴史の学徒は誰しもが過去から学ぶ力を持つ。偉大な者たちはそれを自らの利益のために用いる。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

quotes.name: Sanctum of Shattered Heights
quotes.flavor:
Rage smolders within,
An all-consuming wildfire
Burning fear to ash

quotes.name: Meekstone
quotes.flavor: The bigger they are, the stronger its pull.

quotes.name: Retrieve
quotes.flavor: The roots preserved the armor for a hundred years, safeguarding it for a traveler in need.

quotes.name: Chandra's Magmutt
quotes.flavor:
"Is it purebred? No, but it's pure fire."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Grim Physician
quotes.flavor: The Returned retain no memory of their identities, but sometimes they mindlessly attempt familiar tasks.

quotes.name: Spectral Sailor
quotes.flavor:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
quotes.flavor: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Improbable Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

quotes.name: Portal to Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

quotes.name: Cyclonic Rift
quotes.flavor: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

quotes.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
quotes.flavor: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

quotes.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
quotes.flavor: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

quotes.name: Assassin's Trophy
quotes.flavor: "Who are these . . . freaks? How do they know to fight like that? Answer me, or hang here until you die."

quotes.name: Rakdos Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

quotes.name: Excruciator
quotes.flavor:
"Though used as a piercing weapon, the tusk is more akin to a stinger, spreading pain instantly throughout the body of its victim. This specimen deserves further study."
—Simic research notes

quotes.name: Sea Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

quotes.name: Jolene, Plundering Pugilist
quotes.flavor: "So, are we doing this the easy way or the fun way?"

quotes.name: Armored Pegasus
quotes.flavor:
"I always charge a little extra to take on a pegasus. They fly like eagles, kick like mules, and hide like hermits."
—Tahli *en*-Dal, bounty hunter

quotes.name: Monstrous Growth
quotes.flavor: Some cats are born fighters; others need a little persuading.

quotes.name: Devour in Shadow
quotes.flavor:
"Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

quotes.name: Runed Servitor
quotes.flavor: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

quotes.name: Seasoned Hallowblade
quotes.flavor: "I don't know that I'll win every fight. But I have faith, and that's carried me this far."

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: When you sink a lot of ships, it's easy to find sunken treasure.

quotes.name: Gale, Waterdeep Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "Swords, meet sorcery!"

quotes.name: Air-Cult Elemental
quotes.flavor: Elemental Evil distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.

quotes.name: Light the Way
quotes.flavor: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

quotes.name: Balance of Power
quotes.flavor:
"To empty your mind is to fill your grave."
—Lat-Nam teaching

quotes.name: Hunted Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Even after Hanweir was saved, Gisa's lost ghouls would shamble through, still following the twisted orders of their imprisoned master.

quotes.name: Doomgape
quotes.flavor: It eats and eats until the juiciest morsel it can find is itself.

quotes.name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
quotes.flavor: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

quotes.name: Animation Module
quotes.flavor: Design leads to progress.

quotes.name: Raptor Companion
quotes.flavor: A raptor will follow any order as long as that order is "hunt," "kill," or "go for the guts."

quotes.name: Vanquish the Horde
quotes.flavor:
"Invading Wakanda is the last mistake you will ever make, Doom."
—Shuri, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Temur Sabertooth
quotes.flavor: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

quotes.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
quotes.flavor: "What will become of our triumphs? Our hopes? Our... our despair?"

quotes.name: Swab Goblin
quotes.flavor: Though small, goblins can hold their own in a fight. Foolhardy confidence goes a long way.

quotes.name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
quotes.flavor: "You burn. I'll pillage."

quotes.name: Hooting Mandrills
quotes.flavor: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Candy Trail
quotes.flavor:
"Look! Another one! Who cares what Mother said? We'll be home before she gets back."
—Daniela, Edgewall youth

quotes.name: Builder's Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Mix the mortar with holy wards, or blood will run in the streets."
—Vadvar, Thraben stonewright

quotes.name: Gustcloak Harrier
quotes.flavor: Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.

quotes.name: Hour of Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"Tomorrow's sun will rise on a new king of Wakanda!"
—Erik Killmonger

quotes.name: Lumengrid Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The vedalken order their Neurok sentinels to watch over the shores of the Quicksilver Sea, as if they know of intruders yet to come.

quotes.name: Dead Weight
quotes.flavor:
"You're not my quarry, little one. I'm after whatever comes to investigate your cries."
—Kelsien, the Plague

quotes.name: Intrepid Hero
quotes.flavor: A fool knows no fear. A hero shows no fear.

quotes.name: Hyrax Tower Scout
quotes.flavor: The scouts of Hyrax Tower keep watch at the edge of Setessan territory, protecting the polis from inhuman monsters and enemy armies.

quotes.name: Burning Anger
quotes.flavor: "With rage as your forge, your hammer can smite anything."

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

quotes.name: Arena Athlete
quotes.flavor: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

quotes.name: Glory Seeker
quotes.flavor: "There's no contract to sign, no oath to swear. The enlistment procedure is to unsheathe your sword and point it at the enemy."

quotes.name: Mischievous Chimera
quotes.flavor: Some curiosities are best left alone.

quotes.name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
quotes.flavor:
After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos. She found that they were quick to take offense, not because they were thin-skinned, but because they were always eager for a fight.
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Mindspring Merfolk
quotes.flavor: "Suck my seaweed!"

quotes.name: Razorclaw Bear
quotes.flavor:
One razorclaw is three bears too many.
—Elvish saying

quotes.name: Planar Portal
quotes.flavor: These devices have been known to pull entire worlds through the Æther.

quotes.name: Song of the Dryads
quotes.flavor: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

quotes.name: Hour of Promise
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

quotes.name: Angel's Feather
quotes.flavor: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Ezio Auditore da Firenze
quotes.flavor: "We work in the dark to serve the light. We are Assassins."

quotes.name: Black Cat
quotes.flavor: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

quotes.name: Knight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

quotes.name: Mishra's Helix
quotes.flavor: The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

quotes.name: Merrow Reejerey
quotes.flavor: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

quotes.name: Choke
quotes.flavor:
"One day we shall walk where once was water."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Giant Killer // Chop Down
quotes.flavor: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

quotes.name: Argivian Archaeologist
quotes.flavor: Fascinated by the lore of ancient struggles, archaeologists search incessantly for remnants of an earlier, more powerful era.

quotes.name: Price of Progress
quotes.flavor: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

quotes.name: Famine
quotes.flavor: "But it was a year of dearth. People were reduced to eating leaves of jujube trees. Corpses were seen everywhere in the countryside."

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "I am the bridge between sea and sky. Wind and waves alike rise at my whim."

quotes.name: Count on Luck
quotes.flavor: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

quotes.name: Treasonous Ogre
quotes.flavor:
"Everything comes with a price. Especially revolution."
—Grenzo, dungeon warden

quotes.name: Inspiring Call
quotes.flavor: Loyal members of the Enlightened return to Point Pleasant during the seasonal equinox to honor the Wise Mothman, despite interference from the blasphemous "Dim Ones."

quotes.name: Blood Sun
quotes.flavor: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

quotes.name: Misthollow Griffin
quotes.flavor: For some creatures, existing is only a whim.

quotes.name: Demonspine Whip
quotes.flavor: Using a spine to break a slave's back appeals to the Grixis sense of irony.

quotes.name: Thundering Giant
quotes.flavor: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

quotes.name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
quotes.flavor: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

quotes.name: Feldon's Cane
quotes.flavor: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: The ancient Chaos Emeralds possess unfathomable power. When all seven Emeralds are gathered, their power is amplified immeasurably.

quotes.name: Stitcher's Apprentice
quotes.flavor: "Oglor create life, Oglor take it away. Oglor god! . . . until Master return."

quotes.name: Witching Well
quotes.flavor: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

quotes.name: Wrecking Ball
quotes.flavor: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

quotes.name: Altar's Reap
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

quotes.name: Tendrils of Despair
quotes.flavor:
"Because I am incapable of tears does not mean I have no need to shed them."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Warrior Angel
quotes.flavor: She represents not hope, but hope's desperate fury.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "You can't learn to enjoy life's amusements in the pages of books. You must seek them out in earnest."

quotes.name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
quotes.flavor: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

quotes.name: Pernicious Deed
quotes.flavor: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

quotes.name: Fireslinger
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Glory Bearers
quotes.flavor: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

quotes.name: Iceman and Firestar
quotes.flavor:
"Aren't my friends amazing?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Goblin Secret Agent
quotes.flavor:
SECRET AGENT
PD042198
LICENSE TO BE KILLED

quotes.name: Hagra Sharpshooter
quotes.flavor: "It's hard to find their weak points, but I very much enjoy the discovery process."

quotes.name: Smite the Monstrous
quotes.flavor: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.

quotes.name: Incubator Drone
quotes.flavor: The touch of an Eldrazi brings life and death in turn.

quotes.name: Sanctify
quotes.flavor:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

quotes.name: Mountain
quotes.flavor: You meant to simply rest in Hundelstone, but the miners have told you stories of whispers in the dark below.

quotes.name: Nature's Lore
quotes.flavor: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

quotes.name: Embalmer's Tools
quotes.flavor:
"They might be dead, but these mummies are masters of their trade."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Last March of the Ents
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"To Isengard with doom we come!
With doom we come, with doom we come!"

quotes.name: Wooded Bastion
quotes.flavor: The elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood continually expand the palisade surrounding the sanctuary. They hope to one day enclose the entire forest within its walls.

quotes.name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
quotes.flavor: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

quotes.name: Lagonna-Band Elder
quotes.flavor: "The best lessons are not the ones I teach. They are the ones the pupils realize for themselves."

quotes.name: Wandering Wolf
quotes.flavor: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Compy Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"There's no reason for it to fear man."
—Robert Burke

quotes.name: Persuasion
quotes.flavor: There's no telling what an accomplished mage might collect.

quotes.name: Concentrate
quotes.flavor: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

quotes.name: The Last Ride
quotes.flavor: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.

quotes.name: Ashnod's Altar
quotes.flavor:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Lattice-Blade Mantis
quotes.flavor:
"Urabrask doesn't think big enough."
—Glissa Sunslayer

quotes.name: Meteor Blast
quotes.flavor:
"Behold astronomy's contribution to war."
—Fennor Rhyl, starcaller

quotes.name: Alaborn Musketeer
quotes.flavor: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

quotes.name: Salvage
quotes.flavor:
"What was taken shall be restored."
—Arathel, elvish queen

quotes.name: Ornery Goblin
quotes.flavor: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

quotes.name: Nirkana Assassin
quotes.flavor: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

quotes.name: Defy Death
quotes.flavor: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers. "A fitting end," she murmured as she raised her sword.

quotes.name: Followed Footsteps
quotes.flavor: Æther can turn a footprint into a blueprint.

quotes.name: Myrsmith
quotes.flavor: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

quotes.name: Black Market
quotes.flavor: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

quotes.name: Mountain
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.

quotes.name: Reckless Fireweaver
quotes.flavor: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

quotes.name: Fumigate
quotes.flavor: The one small garden of a free gardener was all Sam's need and due, not a garden swollen to a realm; his own hands to use, not the hands of others to command.

quotes.name: The Tarrasque
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: When it rises, nations fall.

quotes.name: Pensive Minotaur
quotes.flavor:
The Champion and her companions marched through the night, but the battle was over before they arrived. In the middle of the carnage sat a solitary minotaur, lost in what seemed to the Champion to be thought.
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Burn the Accursed
quotes.flavor: Nothing remained but a few drifting embers and the smell of smoldering hair.

quotes.name: Umbral Expanse
quotes.flavor: A neglected corner of the Adumbral Gardens, used by pages and diplomats seeking solitude for reflection and intrigue.

quotes.name: Rend Flesh
quotes.flavor:
"The Reito Massacre was a testament to the kami's unstoppable power. The human defenders might as well have been moths battling a forest fire."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Lórien Revealed
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lórien and be glad!"
—Haldir

quotes.name: Timetwister
quotes.flavor: 2021 Vintage Champion

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: When you spend most of your time running for your life, it pays to invest in quality footwear.

quotes.name: Loyal Guardian
quotes.flavor: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Iroas's Champion
quotes.flavor: Accustomed to battling before an audience in the arena, Iroas's champions know how to put on a good show.

quotes.name: The Last Ronin's Technique
quotes.flavor: "See you on the other side, bros."

quotes.name: Fangblade Brigand // Fangblade Eviscerator
quotes.flavor: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

quotes.name: Throatseeker
quotes.flavor:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words

quotes.name: Temple of Triumph
quotes.flavor: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

quotes.name: Seal of Cleansing
quotes.flavor:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: Sandsteppe Citadel
quotes.flavor: That which endures, survives.

quotes.name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
quotes.flavor: Gerrard's final act ensured his legacy would never die.

quotes.name: Grey Host Reinforcements
quotes.flavor:
"I hope they haven't forgotten how to fight."
—Gimli

quotes.name: Ego Drain
quotes.flavor: "You've wasted your life. Let's see if I can do any better with it."

quotes.name: Crushing Vines
quotes.flavor:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters. This dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Mother of Goons
quotes.flavor: "Word to me."

quotes.name: Murmuration
quotes.flavor: Once the crow birdfolk realized augurs were using the shapes of their murmurations for divination, they decided to have some fun with it.

quotes.name: Crimson Hellkite
quotes.flavor: The hellkites are artists with flames, painting the world with fire.

quotes.name: Hold the Line
quotes.flavor: "Forgive me, Master Kami, but in the interest of my people I must halt your advance."

quotes.name: Blazing Crescendo
quotes.flavor:
"I learned this little trick from Koth."
—Chandra

quotes.name: Furious Strength
quotes.flavor:
"Time for my closing argument!"
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

quotes.name: Malevolent Hermit // Benevolent Geist
quotes.flavor: All his old grudges suddenly seemed laughably petty. So he laughed.

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
「苦痛、苦悩、不浄、恐怖、肉体を剥ぎ捨てよ。それらを明け渡せば、一つとなって祝福を受けるだろう。」
――「ファイレクシアの聖句」

quotes.name: Gavony Unhallowed
quotes.flavor:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

quotes.name: Eumidian Hatchery
quotes.flavor: Eumidians do their work knowing that only future generations will see it finished.

quotes.name: Viashino Bey
quotes.flavor:
When the bey runs, match his stride.
—Viashino saying

quotes.name: Kang the Conqueror
quotes.flavor: "My time . . . is all times."

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Vow of Flight
quotes.flavor:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

quotes.name: Knighted Myr
quotes.flavor:
"This one fights like a leonin!"
—Jor Kadeen

quotes.name: Gideon's Sacrifice
quotes.flavor: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

quotes.name: Ray of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.

quotes.name: Cogwork Librarian
quotes.flavor: Why wait for answers?

quotes.name: Festering Newt
quotes.flavor: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

quotes.name: Valorous Charge
quotes.flavor: Stand in the way of truth at your peril.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Elvish Eulogist
quotes.flavor: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

quotes.name: Deathleaper, Terror Weapon
quotes.flavor: Created to break will and bone with equal ferocity.

quotes.name: Nimble Mongoose
quotes.flavor: One thread connected all the travelers' stories: the ferocity of the mongoose.

quotes.name: Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned
quotes.flavor: In Lim-Dûl's stead may he forever reign.

quotes.name: Cruel Tutor
quotes.flavor: The more you pay for the lesson, the better you'll remember it.

quotes.name: Devouring Light
quotes.flavor: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

quotes.name: Spirit Link
quotes.flavor: "We are all inextricably linked, souls woven in tapestry."

quotes.name: Bitterblade Warrior
quotes.flavor: "The vizier of poisons teaches an unconventional kind of strength."

quotes.name: Armored Whirl Turtle
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.

quotes.name: Johann, Apprentice Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "Okay. First I'll calm the elementals. Then I'll put out the fire. Then I'll unflood the basement. Then I'll do the chores *myself*."

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.flavor: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

quotes.name: Incandescent Aria
quotes.flavor: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.

quotes.name: Mossfire Egg
quotes.flavor:
"Can you feel your instincts overwhelm your reason?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

quotes.name: Enduring Scalelord
quotes.flavor: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Exalted Dragon
quotes.flavor: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

quotes.name: Breaker of Armies
quotes.flavor:
"There are some who have lost everyone and everything. They actively seek out the Eldrazi, eager for the smallest measure of vengeance."
—Munda, ambush leader

quotes.name: Spider-Punk
quotes.flavor: "Disrespect authority. Smash the system."

quotes.name: Runic Armasaur
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: The planet itself has no value. The more efficiently the Borg can extract what they need, the better.

quotes.name: _____ Goblin
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium has never been a place for self-restraint.

quotes.name: Graveshifter
quotes.flavor: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

quotes.name: Hollowhenge Beast
quotes.flavor: In a world of monsters, it's the stuff of nightmares.

quotes.name: The Nipton Lottery
quotes.flavor: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

quotes.name: Metropolis Reformer
quotes.flavor: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

quotes.name: Frontier Warmonger
quotes.flavor: She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: "Catch!"

quotes.name: Tax Collector
quotes.flavor: Few things in this world are as certain.

quotes.name: Forgotten Sentinel
quotes.flavor: It was built to withstand the ages, but no one remembers who built it or why it keeps its eternal watch.

quotes.name: Heartwood Storyteller
quotes.flavor: His roots reach deep, nurtured not by soil and rain, but by millennia of experience.

quotes.name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power... and his hunger.

quotes.name: Legion's Landing // Adanto, the First Fort
quotes.flavor:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

quotes.name: Tarox Bladewing
quotes.flavor: Despising his siblings as insults to his line, he finds and devours each in turn.

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

quotes.name: Progenitus
quotes.flavor: The Soul of the World has returned.

quotes.name: The Second Doctor
quotes.flavor: "Well . . . it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: The gladiatorial stadiums on New Phyrexia echo day and night with the sounds of grinding metal and tearing flesh.

quotes.name: Free Borg Revolutionaries
quotes.flavor: "Resistance is *not* futile."

quotes.name: Mouse Trapper
quotes.flavor: "I'm not here to hurt you, but I will stop you from hurting others."

quotes.name: You're Confronted by Robbers
quotes.flavor: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.

quotes.name: Abzan Falconer
quotes.flavor: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

quotes.name: The Modern Age // Vector Glider
quotes.flavor: It drifted from the spirit realm into a neon world full of new possibilities . . . and decided to stay.

quotes.name: Tar Snare
quotes.flavor: The amorphous, magically animated residue known as the Fathom Sludge lurks in the Hagra Cistern, attacking its prey with pseudopods and dragging it down to be digested.

quotes.name: Charity Extractor
quotes.flavor: "War or no war, your donations are due, as always."

quotes.name: Ethereal Guidance
quotes.flavor:
"The call of the Blessed Sleep is not so strong as the call to protect those in need."
—Saint Traft

quotes.name: Progenitus
quotes.flavor: The Soul of the World has returned.

quotes.name: Scattered Groves
quotes.flavor: Awaiting harvest around the Groves family cabin are plump pumpkins, hearty carrots, juicy mutfruit, and ravenous scorchbeasts.

quotes.name: Firebending Student
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is the element of power."
—Iroh

quotes.name: Colossal Dreadmaw
quotes.flavor:
"Remember when it was the most terrifying thing you'd ever seen?"
—Captain Lannery Storm

quotes.name: Double Down
quotes.flavor: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.

quotes.name: Canopy Baloth
quotes.flavor:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Line Cutter
quotes.flavor: Waiting is for chumps with flimsy spacesuits.

quotes.name: Urza's Tower
quotes.flavor: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

quotes.name: Enter the Enigma
quotes.flavor: Though she was used to stepping into the unknown, something about this strange doorway made the Wanderer shiver as she crossed the threshold.

quotes.name: Crude Bent Blade
quotes.flavor: Clever and cruel, Goblins were particularly good at making instruments of torture and destruction.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

quotes.name: Akul the Unrepentant
quotes.flavor: Crackling with rage and stolen thunder, he drives the Hellspurs to ever-greater heights of violence.

quotes.name: Intrepid Stablemaster
quotes.flavor: "Never get too cocky. Remember you stay upright only by your mount's good graces."

quotes.name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal
quotes.flavor: "For the sake of all, I beseech thee: deliver us from this fate!"

quotes.name: Overwhelming Intellect
quotes.flavor: "My brain hurts."

quotes.name: Pennon Blade
quotes.flavor: Draped with the pennon of a fallen outpost, the sword came to symbolize the peoples of Zendikar becoming one.

quotes.name: Applied Geometry
quotes.flavor: "I know the prompt was to replicate a scurrid, but I took some creative liberties with my version."

quotes.name: Honden of Cleansing Fire
quotes.flavor: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.

quotes.name: Town Gossipmonger // Incited Rabble
quotes.flavor: Rumors are sparks: gather enough of them and something's going to catch fire.

quotes.name: Patriarch's Bidding
quotes.flavor:
"There's some new darkness in the air tonight. If I were you, I'd stay home and lock the doors."
—Ferrick, village warden

quotes.name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
quotes.flavor: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

quotes.name: Maalfeld Twins
quotes.flavor:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Gisa the Mad

quotes.name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
quotes.flavor: "I order you to volunteer."

quotes.name: Water Elemental
quotes.flavor: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

quotes.name: Skulking Ghost
quotes.flavor:
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow guildmage

quotes.name: Vastwood Fortification // Vastwood Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"Never underestimate the ferocity of the imperative to thrive."
—Eyza, Joraga guide

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Raugrin Triome
quotes.flavor: Raugrin meets the sea with jaws wide, its coast spiked with teeth of crystal and granite.

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

quotes.name: Snarling Gorehound
quotes.flavor:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith

quotes.name: Prosperous Partnership
quotes.flavor: Partners in love, partners in life, and partners in crime.

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Riveteers Initiate
quotes.flavor: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.

quotes.name: Skymarch Bloodletter
quotes.flavor: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

quotes.name: Nessian Hornbeetle
quotes.flavor:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

quotes.name: Grab the Prize
quotes.flavor: Unfortunately, the keyhole turned out to be located in an even larger, scarier clown mouth.

quotes.name: Viashino Grappler
quotes.flavor:
"They've returned for the mana rig, but it no longer belongs to them."
—Viashino bey

quotes.name: Leyline Invocation
quotes.flavor:
"Do you still believe my work is nothing but dry, boring equations?"
—Cairu, Quandrix mage-student

quotes.name: Informed Inkwright
quotes.flavor: "My inklings are ideal for gathering information. There's no place on Arcavios they can't reach."

quotes.name: Centaur Battlemaster
quotes.flavor:
"A herd is only as strong as its weakest. Our weakest just killed his third minotaur raider—today."
—Braulios of Pheres Band

quotes.name: Beacon of Unrest
quotes.flavor: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

quotes.name: Council's Deliberation
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"I will take the Ring to Mordor, though I do not know the way."
—Frodo

quotes.name: Senate Courier
quotes.flavor:
"This Dovin Baan came from nowhere. Watch him. Read his letters. He is more than he appears."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Raka Disciple
quotes.flavor: "The strong can also be subtle."

quotes.name: Wakestone Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

quotes.name: Fatehold Annex
quotes.flavor: Battlemages of Fatehold, the school of future history, sift through infinite potentials to write the future they desire.

quotes.name: Bloodgift Demon
quotes.flavor: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

quotes.name: Dowsing Dagger // Lost Vale
quotes.flavor: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

quotes.name: Zombie Master
quotes.flavor: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

quotes.name: Primordial Pachyderm
quotes.flavor:
"Have at me, and we will find out who is the fittest among us."
—Manmoth

quotes.name: Defile
quotes.flavor: "On a failed save, target creature takes 8d8 necrotic damage."

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

quotes.name: Visionary's Dance
quotes.flavor: Choreography powers the spell, but improvisation shapes it.
